# uptimekuma_settings (Data Source)

The instance's general settings, as a JSON object. Which keys exist depends on the Uptime Kuma version, so this is returned untyped rather than as fixed attributes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uptimekuma_settings" "current" {}

output "retention_days" {
  value = jsondecode(data.uptimekuma_settings.current.settings).keepDataPeriodDays
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `settings` (String) Every setting the server reports, as a JSON object.
